scope: SC-K01-OR-001 only; caller-supplied outer_race; offline evaluation preparation
allocation_basis: Independent requested decisions, not lexical variants; related questions stay in one family and split. Debug contains known generic K02 development intents. Heldout uses five narrower new request goals after input-only exposure inventory; no observed rankings used.
heldout_visibility: Authoring agents/researchers may read questions and rubrics. Heldout requests must not be sent to retrievers or generators in E01. Not an independent researcher-blind test.
dependency_unit: All questions share one scenario and 11 registered evidence cards; neither questions nor repeated outputs are independent devices or knowledge domains.
supported_comparison: Future paired descriptive comparison of four configurations within this scenario after all execution gates are frozen.
stop: No retrieval even on debug questions, no generated answers, no semantic verification pipeline, no classifier, no API/web, no scenario expansion. Stop after E01 acceptance and plan registration.
